data.narrative:
KP Labs is a Series A-stage space and aerospace company founded by Krzysztof Pacan. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 3 private companies at Series A and adjacent stages within the same sector, supplemented by reference to 5 public Space & Aerospace comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 additional private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and Planet Labs.

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach. The three direct comparables—Cowboy Space Corporation at $2.0B (Series B), Aalyria at $1.3B (Series B), and Starcloud at $1.1B (Seed)—yield a median valuation of $1.3B with a range spanning $1.1B to $2.0B. Public-comp anchoring using the sector's 25.3x price-to-sales multiple cannot be applied in the absence of the target's disclosed revenue, a common limitation for private company analysis. The median public comparable valuation does not generate an independent data point for triangulation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.1B to $1.5B, centered on $1.3B derived from peer medians. Key uncertainties include KP Labs' revenue trajectory relative to stage-matched peers, capital efficiency and burn profile, and the stage-specific discount (or premium) applicable to Series A positioning. The single-method triangulation limits confidence; additional data on customer traction or capital raised would refine the range.
